n9b228ba939.headline: Trump’s steel tariffs would damage UK and US, says Business Secretary
n9b228ba939.summary: Business Secretary Jonathan Reynolds said Trump's steel tariffs would damage the UK and US. He set out a package worth up to £2.5 billion to support the UK steel industry.
n9b228ba939.why: Steel tariffs affect trade flows, input costs for manufacturers and the earnings outlook of steelmakers across both economies.

ne9e13373e0.headline: Trump’s steel tariffs would damage UK and US, says Business Secretary
ne9e13373e0.summary: Business Secretary Jonathan Reynolds set out a package worth up to £2.5 billion to support the steel industry. He said Trump's steel tariffs would damage both the UK and the US.
ne9e13373e0.why: Steel tariffs affect trade flows and costs for manufacturers and producers across the Atlantic. Government support packages can shape the outlook for domestic steelmakers.

n03be5d8dfe.headline: Thousands of drivers will face £5,500 car tax bill within weeks
n03be5d8dfe.summary: Car road tax bands in the UK are calculated using CO2 emissions and a vehicle's list price, a system in place since 2017. Thousands of drivers face bills of £5,500 within weeks.
n03be5d8dfe.why: Vehicle taxation affects car purchase costs and demand, which matters for carmakers and the wider automotive sector.

n9189a5a149.headline: PZ Cussons to convert N51.79bn loan from UK investor to equity
n9189a5a149.summary: PZ Cussons Nigeria will convert a N51.79 billion intercompany loan from its UK-based parent, PZ Cussons Holdings, into equity as part of a financial restructuring.
n9189a5a149.why: PZ Cussons Nigeria is the local unit of a UK consumer goods group, and debt-to-equity conversions change a subsidiary's balance sheet and funding structure.

n69274f5e9e.headline: USD 21 mn for voter turnout in India: Elon Musk-led DOGE cuts grant
n69274f5e9e.summary: The US Department of Government Efficiency, led by Elon Musk, announced expenditure cuts including $21 million allocated for voter turnout in India.
n69274f5e9e.why: DOGE is a US government efficiency initiative whose spending cuts affect foreign aid programs and US fiscal policy.

n6b313553b2.headline: HMRC tweak that has gone 'under radar' means 'thousands more people will pay'
n6b313553b2.summary: An expert warned that a tweak by the Labour government, described as going under the radar, will see thousands more people pay inheritance tax in the coming years.
n6b313553b2.why: Inheritance tax rules affect estate planning, household wealth transfers and tax revenue collected by HM Revenue and Customs.

nd665b8abe5.headline: Australia bans foreigners from buying established homes ahead of elections
nd665b8abe5.summary: Australia will ban foreign investors from buying established houses from April 1 until March 31, 2027, with the restriction to be reviewed for possible extension, housing minister Clare O'Neil said.
nd665b8abe5.why: Foreign buyer restrictions affect demand in Australia's residential property market, which is a major asset class for local banks and investors.

na9cebf040c.headline: Australia to impose two-year ban on foreigners buying property
na9cebf040c.summary: The Australian government has announced a two-year ban on foreign entities buying established residential property in the country.
na9cebf040c.why: Australia's housing market is a major driver of household wealth and bank lending, so changes to foreign buyer rules affect property prices and developers.

n09a7d8f464.headline: Price and policy changes redirect Uber's electric drive
n09a7d8f464.summary: Australian ride-share drivers could lose a long-standing electric vehicle discount while gaining another, as Uber changes its pricing and policy.
n09a7d8f464.why: Uber is a global ride-hailing and delivery platform whose driver pricing and incentives affect its gig-economy workforce and costs.

n1beea77486.headline: AUD/USD forecast ahead of RBA decision, FOMC minutes - Invezz
n1beea77486.summary: A forecast for the Australian dollar against the US dollar ahead of an upcoming Reserve Bank of Australia decision and release of Federal Open Market Committee minutes.
n1beea77486.why: The AUD/USD pair reflects the relative interest-rate outlook and economic conditions of Australia and the United States.

nd1bf5c6d1e.headline: Bursa Malaysia to remain in consolidation mode this week on US trade uncertainty
nd1bf5c6d1e.summary: Bursa Malaysia is expected to stay in a consolidation phase this week until greater clarity on US trade policy emerges.
nd1bf5c6d1e.why: Bursa Malaysia is Malaysia's main stock exchange, and its direction often reflects global trade sentiment and regional investor flows.

ne38802010a.headline: Rate that stops the nation: Victorians warned RBA might not cut interest rates because of employment - realestate.com.au
ne38802010a.summary: Major Australian banks have warned there is a significant chance the Reserve Bank will not cut interest rates next week, largely due to employment.
ne38802010a.why: The Reserve Bank of Australia sets the cash rate, which drives mortgage pricing and the yields on Australian government bonds.

nedcc303902.headline: Musk-led DOGE cuts US funding worth $750m in Bangladesh, India, Nepal, 8 other countries
nedcc303902.summary: Projects receiving US funding worth $750m across 11 countries have been cut by the DOGE effort led by Elon Musk. One cut includes $29 million for strengthening the political landscape in Bangladesh.
nedcc303902.why: US foreign aid funding supports development and government programmes abroad, so cuts affect recipient economies and the projects that depend on them.

ncce1615ba3.headline: Contact profit down, earnings up
ncce1615ba3.summary: Contact Energy reported a fall in profit alongside higher earnings, according to the headline. The description provides no further figures.
ncce1615ba3.why: Contact Energy is a New Zealand electricity generator and retailer listed on the NZX. Its profit and earnings are watched by investors in the local utilities sector.

n0f5a9954ef.headline: Australia's Perpetual confirms fresh bid from KKR
n0f5a9954ef.summary: Perpetual confirmed it received an indicative buyout offer from KKR but said recent media reports did not accurately describe the latest revised proposal or its value.
n0f5a9954ef.why: Perpetual is an Australian financial services group, and KKR is a global private equity firm that makes large take-private bids.

n520dceb746.headline: Charting the global economy: US inflation picks up ahead of Trump
n520dceb746.summary: US inflation surged at the start of 2024 on higher grocery, gasoline and housing costs, reducing chances of a Federal Reserve rate cut, while Trump called for reciprocal tariffs.
n520dceb746.why: The Federal Reserve sets US interest rates, and inflation data shapes expectations for rate cuts that affect equities, bonds and the dollar.
n520dceb746.why_moved: Inflation rising on groceries, gasoline and housing reduces the likelihood of a Federal Reserve rate cut, and tariff threats add to trade-war risk.

n2121b6ba55.headline: Louisiana grasped for clean energy jobs. Then came the Trump administration funding pause.
n2121b6ba55.summary: Louisiana had courted wind energy and carbon capture projects to become a clean energy supply chain hub, but a Trump administration funding pause has affected those plans.
n2121b6ba55.why: Federal funding for clean energy projects shapes investment in supply chains such as carbon capture, hydrogen and wind equipment.

n836f5e8c40.headline: Special Cabinet meeting on housing will consider ‘all different actions’
n836f5e8c40.summary: A special Cabinet meeting on housing will consider all different actions, the source reports. Investors will have to help plug the gap in funding as the government faces pressure to increase new builds.
n836f5e8c40.why: Housing supply depends on construction financing, and government policy affects developers, lenders and institutional investors in residential property.

n055a1d6930.headline: FOMC minutes, FII action among 9 factors that could impact D-Street trade this week
n055a1d6930.summary: Indian benchmark indices fell for an eighth straight session, with banks, autos and FMCG among the big losers. Foreign institutional investor selling weighed on the market ahead of key global events.
n055a1d6930.why: Foreign institutional investors are a major source of flows into Indian equities, and their selling can drive sharp moves in the benchmark indices.
n055a1d6930.why_moved: Foreign institutional investor selling drove losses across banks, autos and FMCG stocks, according to the report.

n97396e5583.headline: F&O Talk| Nifty under pressure, targeting fresh lows; strong support seen at 21,280: Rahul Ghose of Hedged.in
n97396e5583.summary: Indian benchmark indices extended their downtrend on Friday, with all 13 major sectors closing in negative territory. Investor sentiment was dampened by concerns linked to U.S. President Donald Trump.
n97396e5583.why: The Nifty 50 is the benchmark index of the National Stock Exchange of India, a key gauge of Indian equity market sentiment.
n97396e5583.why_moved: Investor sentiment was dampened by concerns linked to U.S. President Donald Trump, and all 13 major sectors closed in negative territory.

na1af91143a.headline: CM Majhi to Present Odisha Budget 2025-26 in Assembly
na1af91143a.summary: The Odisha state government is set to present its 2025-26 budget on Monday, with Chief Minister Mohan Charan Majhi to unveil it in the State Legislative Assembly.
na1af91143a.why: State budgets set public spending priorities for infrastructure and development, which affect regional growth, credit demand and local companies.

n9f79f706fb.headline: Price growth, consumption can be stronger: PBOC
n9f79f706fb.summary: PBOC Governor Pan Gongsheng said China's price growth and consumer demand can be stronger, citing a sound economy and reduced risks from local government debt and property. He spoke at a conference in AlUla, Saudi Arabia.
n9f79f706fb.why: The People's Bank of China sets monetary policy for the world's second-largest economy, so its signals shape Chinese rates, the yuan and global commodity demand.

n2f82416dde.headline: MORNING BID ASIA-Dollar, Tech and Tariff Delays Fuel Rotation Plays
n2f82416dde.summary: Japan's fourth-quarter GDP data is the main calendar event, with economists expecting annualized growth of 1.0%, as dollar, tech and tariff factors fuel rotation plays.
n2f82416dde.why: Japan's GDP data is a key gauge of the world's third-largest economy and influences Asian equity and currency positioning.

n78bff1115f.headline: Cryptocurrency promoted by Argentina's Milei crashes
n78bff1115f.summary: Argentina's President Javier Milei admitted to a mistake after promoting a cryptocurrency that soared then crashed.
n78bff1115f.why: Cryptocurrency volatility can influence investor sentiment and regulatory considerations in emerging markets like Argentina.

n0fd73749a4.headline: PSX snaps three-week losing streak on robust economic data
n0fd73749a4.summary: Robust auto sales and increased remittances helped push the KSE 100 index above 112,000 in the outgoing week.
n0fd73749a4.why: The Pakistan Stock Exchange is a key indicator of investor sentiment and economic health in Pakistan, influenced by domestic economic data.
n0fd73749a4.why_moved: Strong economic indicators such as auto sales and remittances improved investor sentiment, reversing the index's prior decline.

ne279614074.headline: Argentina’s President Milei faces impeachment calls after promoting cryptocurrency
ne279614074.summary: Argentine President Javier Milei faces impeachment calls after promoting a cryptocurrency whose price soared then collapsed, causing losses for thousands of investors.
ne279614074.why: Political instability linked to cryptocurrency promotion can affect Argentina’s regulatory environment and investor confidence.

n7f190ae9eb.headline: KCCI slams Nepra’s limited relief for Karachi consumers
n7f190ae9eb.summary: The Karachi Chamber of Commerce and Industry condemned Nepra and K-Electric for failing to deliver promised electricity benefits to Karachi consumers.
n7f190ae9eb.why: Electricity supply and pricing issues affect industrial productivity and economic activity in Pakistan’s largest city.

ncb3acf32ff.headline: Step by step: how was the maneuver with the crypto promoted by Milei?
ncb3acf32ff.summary: Following a social media post by President Milei, the crypto token reached a market capitalisation of more than $4 billion. The article traces the steps behind the promotion.
ncb3acf32ff.why: Crypto tokens promoted by public figures are highly speculative and can see rapid valuation swings, which matters for risk management and regulatory scrutiny.

n85de828e3d.summary: Metalworking company Impsa has nearly 10 packages of contracts in progress, and investors are seeking to accelerate them, which could support international projects.
n85de828e3d.why: Impsa is an Argentine metalworking company whose contract flow indicates its order book and growth prospects.

n476486db43.summary: A rift has opened between the League and Forza Italia over Matteo Salvini's push to write off tax debts. Reports describe the proposal as not enough for Forza Italia.
n476486db43.why: Tax debt write-offs affect state revenue collection and the fiscal position of Italy, a major euro-area economy.

nd2dc224a8e.summary: The US government announced the cancellation of funds allocated to various countries across social, political, natural and other sectors. The measure was approved by President Trump and run by Elon Musk.
nd2dc224a8e.why: Foreign aid flows are an important source of funding for developing economies, so cuts can affect public budgets, projects and external financing.
